## Research focus

This coauthored paper examines machine-learning approaches to predicting crop
yield. It compares linear and nonlinear regressors with five-fold
cross-validation, including random forests, nearest-neighbor regression,
polynomial-feature linear regression, and support-vector regression.

The work connects agricultural prediction to empirical model comparison. I am
listed as the second author; the complete author order is retained above and in
the citation.
